name: da-v2-small-baseline
role: Sprint 1 zero-shot baseline (Phase 5 Concept A fallback path). NOT fine-tuned for remote sensing.
architecture: Depth Anything V2 Small: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 encoder, DPT decoder, features=64, out_channels=[48,96,192,384]
training_domain: natural images (595K synthetic + 62M pseudo-labelled real, upstream)
output_semantics: Unitless, per-image affine-ambiguous inverse-depth-like values. Larger = closer to camera. For nadir imagery this is treated as MONOTONIC in surface height (higher value = higher surface) — an assumption, not a calibration.
known_limitations_evidence: Zero-shot metric depth models fail at nadir (Phase 3 E15: AerialMetric delta1~0%).
Zero-shot DA-V2 on DFC2019 satellite scenes: MAE 4.59 m with scale drift (Phase 3 E16, Sat3R).
No remote-sensing adaptation applied in this version.
code_source: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2 @ a561b849ebae10a6f5ef49e26c83cbbcd36c71bf (vendored under ml/registry/vendor; cv2 import made optional)
validation: none — Sprint 1 pipeline execution only; no accuracy measured
